notes.title: PITACOLAB: CALLING ALL PLAYTESTERS!
notes.content:
Hey, GUUUUYS!
IT'S OUT!,


The first PitacoLab for our new game, A Cat in the Cangaço. This is the time to play and comment! Your feedback will help us improve the game, so don't be shy! To test, just download the corresponding game build from one of the links below:
Android - Build PitacoLab 001,Windows - Build PitacoLab 001,Mac - Build PitacoLab 001
[p align="start"]\[Note for Mac] Since this is an internal testing build only, not the game published in the store, you need to inform MacOS that this is a safe application. There's a guide on how to do this here.

notes.title: Devlog #3: Madame Celeste and Zé Fina - Destiny and Mischief in the Magical Back
notes.content:
Here comes the mirage, cangaceiros!
Today we present the most enigmatic duo in the camp: Madame Celeste Corpo Solto and Zé Fina Rabo Seco.
Madame Celeste: The Truth That Became a Curse
Before: A woman with a full figure, beauty, and charm.

The Mistake: She lied about the fate of a married man.

Punishment: Condemned to wander as just a head in a dome.

Today: She reads letters like someone leafing through a brochure, showing only what suits her.

“With Madame Celeste, your word is your weapon.”


Zé Fina: The Guardian of Destiny
Blue lizard with a dry tail and bulging eyes

Witness to 100 years (and 100 stories) of the sertão

The only remnant of Celeste's previous life

“If the card is good, thank the wind. If it's bad... sit down and endure.”


Visual Concept: From Sketch to MagicCeleste:
